message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This arXiv paper presents a new method, HiSentinel, that trains lightweight sentinels to decide when and how to intervene before a coding agent executes an action, improving task completion by up to 14%. It includes a novel dataset (SWE-Intervene) with annotated intervention feedback and shows consistent improvements across benchmarks and agent types, providing concrete evidence (data and method) relevant to learners about how intervention can prevent error propagation in coding agents.","piece_ids":["01"],"strongest_claim":"HiSentinel's lightweight pre-execution intervention improves autonomous coding agents' task completion by up to 14% while maintaining competitive token usage.","evidence_type":"data","perspective":"research","commercial_incentive":false}
